notes: At risk = a customer with >=1 past order who places NO order in the next 30 days. StratifiedGroupKFold CV grouped by customer (a customer's rows never straddle the train/test split, so the score is honest for unseen customers); highest churned-class F1 wins. Imbalance handled via class_weight='balanced' (logreg/forest) / scale_pos_weight (xgboost).
